label: Late-episode D1 after a rewarded visit to S1
explanation: Fires only at D1 (never GO/D2) and only when the reward input is 1, i.e. the previous trial was rewarded; essentially never before episode trial ~60, and rate rises steeply through trials 70-99 (magnitude also grows late: coverage of ep_trial>=80 rises from 0.67 in the lowest to 1.0 in the top activation quartile). Within that, it is selective for the previous reached state being S1 (whether reached via a1 common or a2 rare), which is why it looks action-a1/good=S1 biased; rewarded S2 visits mostly do not fire it. Co-varies with low value-head output (late-episode). All variables are observed (reward input, previous state, trial index). Dev: P 0.84, R 0.69, F1 0.755, mass recall 0.81; part of the recall loss is the window first trial where prev_state is unknown (prev_state != 2 gives F1 0.76, mass recall 0.95). Remaining misses are weak activations after rewarded S2 visits or at trials 60-80.
